headline: Fed Officials Hint at More Rate Hikes
detail: This is the primary driver for your tech/chip concentration. Higher rates make growth stocks less attractive and increase borrowing costs, especially painful on margin. Expect continued pressure on your leveraged ETFs.
rec: Consider trimming any positions showing weakness, especially leveraged ETFs like SOXL, MUU, SPAL, METU, PLTU, and MSFU, if they break their current stops.

headline: Worker Pay Lags Inflation
detail: This suggests consumer spending power is weakening. While not directly impacting chip demand, it adds to the overall cautious economic sentiment that can pressure growth stocks.

headline: Biopharma Stocks Lead Tech Wreck Winners
detail: This highlights a sector rotation away from traditional tech. Your heavy tech/chip focus means you are on the wrong side of this trend.

headline: Treasury Series I Bond Rate
detail: A 5.51% I bond rate is attractive for risk-averse investors, potentially drawing some capital away from riskier assets like tech stocks.
